zones.name: Metolius / Camp Sherman / Green Ridge
zones.habitat: ponderosa and mixed conifer benches, ditch lines and riparian fringe along the Metolius

zones.name: Santiam Pass / Big Lake / Hwy 20 crest
zones.habitat: true fir and lodgepole around the crest, old B+B and newer burn footprints

zones.name: McKenzie Bridge / Blue River / Hwy 126
zones.habitat: 40-80 yr Doug-fir / hemlock second growth with moss mats, 1000-3000 ft

zones.name: Cascade Lakes Hwy / Elk Lake corridor
zones.habitat: mountain hemlock / lodgepole / fir, late June season, snow lingers

zones.name: La Pine / Newberry flanks
zones.habitat: lodgepole and ponderosa flats, moist swales and old skid roads

zones.name: Willamette Pass / Odell / Crescent Lakes
zones.habitat: fir / lodgepole around the lakes, June melt-out

zones.name: Chemult / Walker Rim / Miller Lake
zones.habitat: lodgepole / ponderosa, classic east-side spring ground

zones.name: Diamond Lake / Lemolo / Windigo Pass
zones.habitat: true fir / mountain hemlock, June morels, short early-Oct fall window before frost

zones.name: North Umpqua corridor / Steamboat / Toketee
zones.habitat: Doug-fir second growth on benches above the river, big fall chanterelle country

zones.name: Prospect / Union Creek / upper Rogue
zones.habitat: mixed conifer, spring morels along the Rogue, fall chanterelles below 4000 ft

zones.name: Klamath westside / Rocky Point / Fourmile
zones.habitat: ponderosa / white fir west of Upper Klamath Lake

zones.name: Ashland watershed / Applegate foothills
zones.habitat: mixed conifer / madrone, late fall chanterelles in mild years, spring morels higher

zones.name: Illinois Valley / Cave Junction
zones.habitat: Doug-fir / tanoak; serpentine soils make habitat patchy, work the non-serpentine conifer stands

zones.name: South coast / Port Orford / Powers / Gold Beach
zones.land: Rogue River-Siskiyou NF (Gold Beach / Powers RD), Coos Bay BLM
zones.habitat: Sitka spruce / shore pine fringe and Doug-fir hills, longest chanterelle season in the state

zones.name: Oregon Dunes / Reedsport / Elliott fringe
zones.land: Siuslaw NF (Oregon Dunes NRA), Elliott State Forest fringe
zones.habitat: shore pine in the dunes for fall kings, spruce / hemlock for chanterelles
